WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_2024
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_sales
    WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023)
        / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    units_2024,
    stock,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * units_2024 / NULLIF(units_2024 + stock, 0),
        1
    ) AS estimated_sell_through_pct
FROM ranked_products
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    country,
    signup_year,
    paid_orders,
    ROUND(lifetime_revenue, 2) AS lifetime_revenue,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN revenue_2023 > 0
            THEN 100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / revenue_2023
        END,
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    products_bought,
    categories,
    ROUND(lifetime_revenue / paid_orders, 2) AS average_order_value,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY country
        ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC
    ) AS country_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders,
        SUM(o.total) AS lifetime_revenue,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        (
            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id)
            FROM orders o2
            JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o2.id
            WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id
              AND o2.status = 'paid'
        ) AS products_bought,
        (
            SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.category)
            FROM orders o3
            JOIN order_items oi3 ON oi3.order_id = o3.id
            JOIN products p ON p.id = oi3.product_id
            WHERE o3.customer_id = c.id
              AND o3.status = 'paid'
        ) AS categories
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o
      ON o.customer_id = c.id
     AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, c.signup_year
) AS customer_metrics
ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH customer_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.country,
        c.is_active,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS spend,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY
        c.id, c.name, c.country, c.is_active, o.order_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cy.*,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cy.country, cy.order_year
            ORDER BY cy.spend DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customer_year AS cy
)
SELECT
    cur.country,
    cur.country_rank,
    cur.name AS customer,
    CASE WHEN cur.is_active = 1 THEN 'active' ELSE 'inactive' END AS customer_status,
    ROUND(cur.spend, 2) AS spend_2024,
    ROUND(COALESCE(prev.spend, 0), 2) AS spend_2023,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN prev.spend IS NULL OR prev.spend = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE 100.0 * (cur.spend - prev.spend) / prev.spend
        END,
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    cur.paid_orders AS paid_orders_2024,
    cur.categories_bought AS categories_bought_2024
FROM ranked AS cur
LEFT JOIN ranked AS prev
    ON prev.customer_id = cur.customer_id
   AND prev.order_year = 2023
WHERE cur.order_year = 2024
  AND cur.country_rank <= 10
ORDER BY cur.country, cur.country_rank, cur.spend DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                       THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS spend_2024,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                       THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS spend_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN p.category END) AS categories_2024,
        ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.total END), 2) AS avg_order_value_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cm.*,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY spend_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customer_metrics AS cm
    WHERE spend_2024 > 0
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    city,
    country,
    signup_year,
    is_active,
    country_rank,
    orders_2024,
    spend_2024,
    spend_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (spend_2024 - spend_2023) / NULLIF(spend_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS spend_growth_pct,
    categories_2024,
    avg_order_value_2024
FROM ranked
ORDER BY spend_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_metrics
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 / NULLIF(orders_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank;

SELECT
    country,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    category,
    revenue_2024,
    revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        category,
        revenue_2024,
        revenue_2023,
        orders_2024,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, customer_id
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.country,
            c.id AS customer_id,
            c.name AS customer_name,
            p.category,
            SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2024,
            SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2023,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id
            END) AS orders_2024
        FROM customers AS c
        JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.customer_id = c.id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE c.is_active = 1
          AND o.status = 'paid'
          AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
        GROUP BY
            c.country,
            c.id,
            c.name,
            p.category
    )
    WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
)
WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country, category, category_rank;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
analytical AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        orders,
        customers,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year) AS yearly_revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(yearly_revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue_share_pct,
    orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0), 2) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM analytical
ORDER BY order_year, category_rank, category;

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        o.total
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
),
customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(po.id) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(po.total), 2) AS total_spend,
        ROUND(AVG(po.total), 2) AS average_order_value,
        MIN(po.order_year) AS first_paid_year,
        MAX(po.order_year) AS last_paid_year
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN paid_orders AS po
      ON po.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
category_reach AS (
    SELECT
        po.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_purchased
    FROM paid_orders AS po
    JOIN order_items AS oi
      ON oi.order_id = po.id
    JOIN products AS p
      ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY po.customer_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        COALESCE(cr.categories_purchased, 0) AS categories_purchased,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.country
            ORDER BY cs.total_spend DESC, cs.paid_orders DESC
        ) AS country_spend_rank
    FROM customer_spend AS cs
    LEFT JOIN category_reach AS cr
      ON cr.customer_id = cs.customer_id
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    country,
    city,
    is_active,
    signup_year,
    paid_orders,
    total_spend,
    average_order_value,
    categories_purchased,
    first_paid_year,
    last_paid_year,
    country_spend_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE country_spend_rank <= 10
ORDER BY country, country_spend_rank, total_spend DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH yearly_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        paid_orders,
        customers,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue
    FROM yearly_category_sales
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS category_rank
FROM scored
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_active = 1 THEN o.customer_id END) AS active_customers,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.category, o.order_year
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        order_year,
        revenue,
        orders,
        customers,
        active_customers,
        units_sold,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
        ) AS yearly_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    category,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(yearly_revenue, 0), 1) AS share_of_yearly_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * active_customers / NULLIF(customers, 0), 1) AS active_customer_pct,
    units_sold,
    category_rank
FROM metrics
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank, category;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS unique_customers,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.order_year
        END) AS last_sale_year
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY
        p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        product_sales.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC, name
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product_name,
    price,
    stock,
    units_sold,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    unique_customers,
    last_sale_year,
    ROUND(
        CASE WHEN units_sold > 0
             THEN CAST(stock AS REAL) / units_sold
        END,
        2
    ) AS stock_to_sales_ratio
FROM ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN revenue_2023 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) * 100.0 / revenue_2023
        END,
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024,
    category_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country, category_rank, category;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2024
    GROUP BY p.category, o.order_year
),
trends AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        order_year,
        revenue,
        paid_orders,
        customers,
        units_sold,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    category,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    units_sold,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS yearly_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue
        / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year), 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM trends
ORDER BY order_year DESC, yearly_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id END) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id END) AS customers
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
        ) AS category_avg_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER () AS total_revenue
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
    name,
    category,
    price,
    stock,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(category_avg_revenue, 2) AS category_avg_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(total_revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue_share_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN units_sold = 0 THEN 'no paid sales'
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out of stock'
        WHEN stock < units_sold THEN 'restock urgently'
        WHEN revenue > category_avg_revenue THEN 'above category average'
        ELSE 'steady performer'
    END AS insight
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 5
ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                            THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                            THEN o.customer_id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue_2023,
        revenue_2024,
        revenue_2024 - revenue_2023 AS revenue_change,
        ROUND(

            1
        ) AS revenue_growth_pct
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN customer_year_sales AS s23
        ON s23.customer_id = c.id
       AND s23.order_year = 2023
    LEFT JOIN customer_year_sales AS s24
        ON s24.customer_id = c.id
       AND s24.order_year = 2024
    LEFT JOIN favorite_category AS fc
        ON fc.customer_id = c.id
       AND fc.category_rank = 1
    WHERE COALESCE(s24.revenue, 0) > 0
)
SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY country
        ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
    ) AS country_revenue_rank
FROM scored_customers
ORDER BY revenue_growth_pct DESC NULLS LAST, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_active = 1 THEN o.customer_id END) AS active_customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year, country
        ) AS country_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year, country
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / country_year_revenue, 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
    orders,
    customers,
    active_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * active_customers / NULLIF(customers, 0), 1) AS active_customer_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year DESC, country, category_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_country AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers,
        ROUND(
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) * 1.0 /
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id),
            2
        ) AS avg_order_value
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue,
        paid_orders,
        customers,
        avg_order_value,
        ROUND(
            revenue * 100.0 /
            SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country),
            1
        ) AS country_revenue_pct,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_country
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    country_revenue_pct,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    avg_order_value,
    category_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    category,
    revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue
        / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country, order_year),
        2
    ) AS revenue_share_pct,
    category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country, o.order_year
            ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC, p.category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year, p.category
) AS ranked_categories
WHERE category_rank = 1
ORDER BY order_year DESC, country
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2022 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2022,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_revenue_2024,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_sales cs
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue_2022, 2) AS revenue_2022,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(country_revenue_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS country_share_pct,
    units_sold,
    customers,
    orders,
    category_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_performance AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.country
        END) AS countries_2024
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    LEFT JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_performance
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    category,
    category_rank,
    revenue_2023,
    revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023)
        / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_percent,
    units_2024,
    customers_2024,
    countries_2024
FROM ranked_products
WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_yearly_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year, p.category
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        category,
        units_sold,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_yearly_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    category,
    category_rank,
    units_sold,
    revenue,
    previous_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_revenue_change_pct
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE category_rank = 1
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.category, o.order_year
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        order_year,
        revenue,
        order_count,
        customer_count,
        LAG(order_year) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_revenue,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    category,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    order_count,
    customer_count,
    revenue_rank,
    ROUND(prior_revenue, 2) AS prior_year_revenue,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN prior_year = order_year - 1
                 AND prior_revenue <> 0
            THEN 100.0 * (revenue - prior_revenue) / prior_revenue
        END,
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM scored
WHERE order_year = 2024
ORDER BY
    yoy_growth_pct IS NULL,
    yoy_growth_pct DESC,
    revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    order_count,
    customer_count,
    units_sold,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_order,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        order_count,
        customer_count,
        units_sold,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            o.order_year,
            p.category,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count,
            SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
    ) AS category_sales
) AS ranked_sales
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH annual_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(o.total) AS spend,
        COUNT(*) AS paid_orders
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.customer_id = c.id
     AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, o.order_year
),
annual_categories AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_year
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        COALESCE(ac.categories_bought, 0) AS categories_bought,
        LAG(a.spend) OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.customer_id
            ORDER BY a.order_year
        ) AS previous_spend,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.country, a.order_year
            ORDER BY a.spend DESC
        ) AS country_year_rank
    FROM annual_spend AS a
    LEFT JOIN annual_categories AS ac
      ON ac.customer_id = a.customer_id
     AND ac.order_year = a.order_year
)
SELECT
    customer_name,
    country,
    order_year,
    paid_orders,
    ROUND(spend, 2) AS spend,
    ROUND(previous_spend, 2) AS previous_spend,
    ROUND(100.0 * (spend - previous_spend) / previous_spend, 1) AS growth_pct,
    categories_bought,
    country_year_rank
FROM scored
WHERE previous_spend > 0
  AND spend > previous_spend
  AND categories_bought >= 2
  AND country_year_rank <= 10
ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, spend DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_country AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id
        END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id
        END) AS customers_2024,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END) AS units_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS country_revenue_2024
    FROM category_country
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(country_revenue_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS country_revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024,
    units_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 / NULLIF(orders_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_performance AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_sold_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN o.id
        END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers_2024,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.category
            ORDER BY
                SUM(CASE
                    WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
                    THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                    ELSE 0
                END) DESC,
                p.name,
                p.id
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,
    revenue_2024,
    revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    units_sold_2024,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024
FROM product_performance
WHERE category_rank <= 10
ORDER BY category, category_rank;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id
            END) AS customers_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue_2023,
        revenue_2024,
        customers_2024,
        revenue_2024
            / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 0)
            AS revenue_share_2024,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023)
        / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_percent,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue_share_2024, 1) AS revenue_share_percent,
    customers_2024
FROM ranked
ORDER BY country, category_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_selling_price
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
),
country_totals AS (
    SELECT country, SUM(revenue) AS country_revenue
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY country
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        ps.*,
        ct.country_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ps.country
            ORDER BY ps.revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM product_sales AS ps
    JOIN country_totals AS ct ON ct.country = ps.country
)
SELECT
    country,
    revenue_rank,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category,
    paid_orders,
    units_sold,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(country_revenue, 0), 2) AS share_of_country_revenue,
    ROUND(avg_selling_price, 2) AS avg_selling_price,
    stock,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'
        WHEN stock < units_sold THEN 'stock_risk'
        ELSE 'adequate_stock'
    END AS inventory_signal
FROM ranked_products
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, revenue_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH yearly_spend AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2024,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN 1 END) AS orders_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
category_mix AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year = 2024
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        c.name,
        c.country,
        c.city,
        ys.spend_2023,
        ys.spend_2024,
        ys.orders_2024,
        COALESCE(cm.categories_bought, 0) AS categories_bought,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * (ys.spend_2024 - ys.spend_2023) / NULLIF(ys.spend_2023, 0),
            1
        ) AS growth_pct,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country
            ORDER BY ys.spend_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearly_spend AS ys ON ys.customer_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN category_mix AS cm ON cm.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE ys.spend_2023 > 0
      AND ys.spend_2024 > ys.spend_2023
)
SELECT
    name,
    country,
    city,
    spend_2023,
    spend_2024,
    growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    categories_bought,
    country_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, country_rank, spend_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    units_sold,
    unique_customers,
    paid_orders,
    revenue_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            o.order_year,
            p.category,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
    ) AS a
)
ORDER BY order_year, revenue_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS unique_customers
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ps.*,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS category_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC, name
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_sales ps
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,
    units_sold,
    unique_customers,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(category_revenue, 0), 2) AS category_revenue_pct,
    stock,
    ROUND(1.0 * stock / NULLIF(units_sold, 0), 2) AS stock_per_unit_sold,
    CASE
        WHEN units_sold = 0 THEN 'No sales'
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'Out of stock'
        WHEN stock < units_sold THEN 'Potential shortage'
        ELSE 'Healthy stock'
    END AS stock_signal
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 10
ORDER BY category, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue_2024,
        revenue_2023,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS country_revenue_2024
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(country_revenue_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS share_of_country_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
  AND revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_demand AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_sold_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers_2024
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(
            CAST(units_sold_2024 AS REAL) / NULLIF(stock + 1, 0),
            2
        ) AS demand_pressure,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY CAST(units_sold_2024 AS REAL) / NULLIF(stock + 1, 0) DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_demand
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    category,
    price,
    stock,
    units_sold_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    customers_2024,
    demand_pressure,
    category_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE units_sold_2024 > 0
ORDER BY demand_pressure DESC, units_sold_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        o.customer_id,
        oi.quantity,
        oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_year = 2023 THEN s.revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_year = 2024 THEN s.revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.order_year = 2024 THEN s.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.order_year = 2024 THEN s.customer_id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM (SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products) AS c
    LEFT JOIN paid_sales AS s ON s.category = c.category
    GROUP BY c.category
)
SELECT
    category,
    revenue_2023,
    revenue_2024,
    units_2024,
    customers_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        2
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (), 0),
        2
    ) AS share_of_2024_revenue_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM category_totals
ORDER BY revenue_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category, o.order_year
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN paid_orders ELSE 0 END) AS paid_orders_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN customers ELSE 0 END) AS customers_2024
    FROM annual
    GROUP BY country, category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    paid_orders_2024,
    customers_2024
FROM ranked
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, country, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    orders_2023,
    customers_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 / NULLIF(orders_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value_2024,
    country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, country_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
    HAVING revenue_2024 > 0
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue_2023,
        revenue_2024,
        customers_2024,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, category
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS country_revenue_2024
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category AS top_category,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    customers_2024,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue_2024 / country_revenue_2024, 1) AS share_of_country_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 - revenue_2023, 2) AS yoy_change,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank = 1
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS total_revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) AS average_order_value,
        MIN(o.order_year) AS first_order_year,
        MAX(o.order_year) AS latest_order_year
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY
        c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country,
        c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
customer_categories AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        COALESCE(cc.categories_bought, 0) AS categories_bought
    FROM customer_spend AS s
    LEFT JOIN customer_categories AS cc
        ON cc.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.paid_orders >= 2
      AND COALESCE(cc.categories_bought, 0) >= 2
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    city,
    country,
    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    categories_bought,
    total_revenue,
    average_order_value,
    first_order_year,
    latest_order_year,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY country
        ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
    ) AS country_revenue_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * total_revenue
        / SUM(total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country),
        1
    ) AS country_revenue_share_pct
FROM qualified_customers
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    category,
    revenue_2024,
    revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN revenue_2023 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) * 100.0 / revenue_2023
        END,
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024,
    category_rank_2024
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue_2024,
        revenue_2023,
        orders_2024,
        customers_2024,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank_2024
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.country,
            p.category,
            SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                     THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
            SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                     THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024
        FROM customers AS c
        JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.customer_id = c.id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
          AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
        GROUP BY c.country, p.category
    )
)
WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY category_rank_2024, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH yearly_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category, o.order_year
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM yearly_category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    revenue,
    units_sold,
    orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(orders, 0), 2) AS average_order_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    category_rank
FROM scored
WHERE order_year = 2024
  AND category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    ranked.country,
    ranked.customer_name,
    ranked.is_active,
    ranked.paid_revenue,
    ranked.paid_orders,
    ROUND(ranked.paid_revenue / ranked.paid_orders, 2) AS average_order_value,
    ranked.categories_purchased,
    ranked.latest_order_year,
    ranked.country_revenue_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        stats.country,
        stats.customer_name,
        stats.is_active,
        stats.paid_revenue,
        stats.paid_orders,
        COALESCE(categories.categories_purchased, 0) AS categories_purchased,
        stats.latest_order_year,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY stats.country
            ORDER BY stats.paid_revenue DESC
        ) AS country_revenue_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.id AS customer_id,
            c.country,
            c.name AS customer_name,
            c.is_active,
            SUM(o.total) AS paid_revenue,
            COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
            MAX(o.order_year) AS latest_order_year
        FROM customers AS c
        JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.customer_id = c.id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY c.id, c.country, c.name, c.is_active
    ) AS stats
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            o.customer_id,
            COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_purchased
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY o.customer_id
    ) AS categories
        ON categories.customer_id = stats.customer_id
) AS ranked
WHERE ranked.country_revenue_rank <= 10
ORDER BY ranked.country, ranked.country_revenue_rank, ranked.customer_name
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    category,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(revenue * 100.0 / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year), 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(previous_revenue, 2) AS previous_year_revenue,
    ROUND(
        (revenue - previous_revenue) * 100.0 / NULLIF(previous_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        category,
        order_year,
        revenue,
        orders,
        customers,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.category,
            o.order_year,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY p.category, o.order_year
    ) AS yearly_category_sales
) AS category_trends
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        o.total,
        c.country
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
),
customer_year AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM paid_orders
    GROUP BY country, order_year, customer_id
),
country_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        COUNT(*) AS paid_customers,
        SUM(order_count) AS paid_orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
        SUM(order_count * 1.0) AS order_count_for_revenue
    FROM customer_year
    GROUP BY country, order_year
),
country_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        SUM(total) AS revenue
    FROM paid_orders
    GROUP BY country, order_year
),
category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        po.country,
        po.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS category_revenue
    FROM paid_orders AS po
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = po.order_id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY po.country, po.order_year, p.category
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY category_revenue DESC, category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_revenue
)
SELECT
    cm.order_year,
    cm.country,
    ROUND(cr.revenue, 2) AS paid_revenue,
    cm.paid_orders,
    cm.paid_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * cm.repeat_customers / cm.paid_customers, 1) AS repeat_customer_pct,
    ROUND(cr.revenue / cm.paid_orders, 2) AS average_order_value,
    rc.category AS top_category,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cm.order_year
        ORDER BY cr.revenue DESC
    ) AS country_revenue_rank
FROM country_metrics AS cm
JOIN country_revenue AS cr
  ON cr.country = cm.country
 AND cr.order_year = cm.order_year
LEFT JOIN ranked_categories AS rc
  ON rc.country = cm.country
 AND rc.order_year = cm.order_year
 AND rc.category_rank = 1
ORDER BY cm.order_year DESC, paid_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year AS year,
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, c.country, p.category
),
trends AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        country,
        category,
        revenue,
        orders,
        customers,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM category_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM trends
)
SELECT
    year,
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    orders,
    customers,
    revenue_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM ranked
ORDER BY year DESC, revenue_rank, country, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

    END AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM (

        ) AS revenue_rank,

            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_revenue,

            PARTITION BY order_year
        ) AS year_total
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.category,

        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'

WITH cohorts AS (

SELECT

    y.order_year,
    y.order_year - co.signup_year AS years_since_signup,
    co.cohort_customers,
    COALESCE(ca.active_customers, 0) AS active_customers,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COALESCE(ca.active_customers, 0) / co.cohort_customers,
        2
    ) AS retention_pct,
    COALESCE(ca.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
    ROUND(COALESCE(ca.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(ca.revenue, 0) / NULLIF(ca.active_customers, 0),
        2
    ) AS revenue_per_active_customer
FROM cohorts AS co

    FROM orders
) AS y

    ON ca.signup_year = co.signup_year
   AND ca.order_year = y.order_year
WHERE y.order_year >= co.signup_year
ORDER BY co.signup_year, y.order_year
LIMIT 50;

            WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2023

WITH yearly_revenue AS (

WITH customer_metrics AS (

        c.id AS customer_id,

        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,

    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY
        c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
country_metrics AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(revenue) AS country_revenue,

    FROM customer_metrics

),
ranked_customers AS (

SELECT

    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        country,

        revenue_2024,
        customers_2024,

        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023)
            / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0)
            AS year_over_year_growth,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(year_over_year_growth, 1) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND(share_of_country_revenue, 1) AS country_revenue_share_pct,
    customers_2024,
    category_rank
FROM scored
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank;

WITH customer_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,

        c.city,

ranked_customers AS (

SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    country,
    category,
    revenue_2023,
    revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) * 100.0 /
        NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY country, category
        ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
    ) AS country_category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        c.country,
        p.category,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS revenue_2023,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 2) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id
        END) AS orders_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE c.is_active = 1
      AND o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, p.category
    HAVING SUM(CASE
        WHEN o.order_year = 2024
        THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
        ELSE 0
    END) > 0
) AS customer_category_sales
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (

        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id END) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id END) AS customers,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2023
                       THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2023,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2024
                       THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2024
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT

        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS country_revenue_2024
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT

    customers,

    revenue_2023,

    ) AS growth_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(country_revenue_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS country_share_pct,

FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country, category_rank, category;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category, o.order_year
),
category_summary AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN orders ELSE 0 END) AS orders_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN customers ELSE 0 END) AS customers_2024
    FROM category_sales
    GROUP BY country, category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_revenue_2024,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, revenue_2023 DESC, category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_summary
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
