    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(country_revenue_2024, 0), 1) AS country_share_pct,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank = 1
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    active_buyers_2024,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY country
        ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
    ) AS category_rank_in_country
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND c.is_active = 1
            THEN c.id
        END) AS active_buyers_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
)
ORDER BY country, category_rank_in_country, category
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    price,
    stock,
    units_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN revenue_2023 > 0
            THEN 100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / revenue_2023
        END,
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    customers_2024,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(stock * price, 2) AS current_inventory_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        x.*,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.category,
            p.id AS product_id,
            p.name AS product_name,
            p.price,
            p.stock,
            SUM(
                CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                     THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END
            ) AS units_2024,
            SUM(
                CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                     THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END
            ) AS revenue_2024,
            SUM(
                CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                     THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END
            ) AS revenue_2023,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id
            END) AS customers_2024
        FROM products AS p
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.product_id = p.id
        JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.id = oi.order_id
           AND o.status = 'paid'
           AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
        GROUP BY
            p.category,
            p.id,
            p.name,
            p.price,
            p.stock
    ) AS x
    WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
) AS ranked
ORDER BY category, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY
        p.category,
        p.id,
        p.name,
        o.order_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY product_id
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM product_year
)
SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    units_sold,
    customers,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN prior_year_revenue > 0
            THEN 100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / prior_year_revenue
        END,
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    ROUND(lifetime_revenue, 2) AS lifetime_revenue,
    ROUND(lifetime_revenue / paid_orders, 2) AS average_order_value,
    first_order_year,
    last_order_year,
    country_rank,
    ROUND(100.0 * lifetime_revenue / country_paid_revenue, 2) AS share_of_country_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders,
        SUM(o.total) AS lifetime_revenue,
        MIN(o.order_year) AS first_order_year,
        MAX(o.order_year) AS last_order_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country
            ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC, COUNT(o.id) DESC, c.id
        ) AS country_rank,
        SUM(SUM(o.total)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country
        ) AS country_paid_revenue
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.customer_id = c.id
     AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, c.is_active
)
WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, country_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o

       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, revenue_2023 DESC, name
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_metrics
    WHERE revenue_2023 > 0 OR revenue_2024 > 0
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,

        (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),

    customers_2024,

WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY category, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        o.total
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(p.total), 2) AS lifetime_revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(p.total), 2) AS average_order_value,
        MIN(p.order_year) AS first_order_year,
        MAX(p.order_year) AS latest_order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT pr.category) AS categories_purchased
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN paid_orders AS p
      ON p.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
      ON oi.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN products AS pr
      ON pr.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY
        c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        p.customer_id,
        pr.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS category_revenue

    JOIN order_items AS oi
      ON oi.order_id = p.order_id
    JOIN products AS pr
      ON pr.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY p.customer_id, pr.category
),
favorite_categories AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY category_revenue DESC, category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_totals
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        m.*,
        f.category AS favorite_category,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY m.country
            ORDER BY m.lifetime_revenue DESC
        ) AS country_revenue_rank
    FROM customer_metrics AS m
    JOIN favorite_categories AS f
      ON f.customer_id = m.customer_id
     AND f.category_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    country,
    city,
    is_active,
    signup_year,
    paid_orders,
    lifetime_revenue,
    average_order_value,
    first_order_year,
    latest_order_year,
    categories_purchased,
    favorite_category,
    country_revenue_rank
FROM ranked_customers
ORDER BY country_revenue_rank, country, lifetime_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH customer_revenue AS (

        c.country,
        c.city,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,

    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, c.city, c.is_active
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS country_rank,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS country_revenue
    FROM customer_revenue
)
SELECT
    country,
    country_rank,
    name,
    city,
    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    distinct_products,
    revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(country_revenue, 0), 1) AS share_of_country_revenue,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(paid_orders, 0), 2) AS average_order_value,
    last_order_year
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, country_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    category,
    order_year,
    revenue,
    units_sold,
    unique_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year), 0), 2) AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY order_year))
        / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY order_year), 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS yearly_revenue_rank
FROM (
    SELECT

        LAG(cr.order_year) OVER (
            PARTITION BY cr.country, cr.category

            PARTITION BY cr.country, cr.order_year

        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,

),
scored AS (

        revenue_2024 - revenue_2023 AS revenue_change,

WITH
categories(category) AS (

),
years(order_year) AS (

),
category_year AS (
    SELECT
        y.order_year,
        c.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM years y

        ON p.category = c.category
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.order_year = y.order_year
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY y.order_year, c.category
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        units_sold,
        customers,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.id, o.customer_id, o.order_year
),
category_breadth AS (
    SELECT
        po.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM paid_orders AS po
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = po.order_id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY po.customer_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(po.order_id) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(po.revenue), 0), 2) AS lifetime_revenue,
        ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(po.revenue), 0), 2) AS average_order_value,
        MAX(po.order_year) AS last_order_year,
        COALESCE(cb.categories_bought, 0) AS categories_bought
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN paid_orders AS po ON po.customer_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN category_breadth AS cb ON cb.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY
        c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.is_active, cb.categories_bought
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cm.*,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC
        ) AS country_rank,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * lifetime_revenue /
            NULLIF(SUM(lifetime_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 0),
            2
        ) AS country_revenue_share_pct
    FROM customer_metrics AS cm
    WHERE lifetime_revenue > 0
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    city,
    country,
    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    lifetime_revenue,
    average_order_value,
    last_order_year,
    categories_bought,

FROM ranked
ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC, country, name
LIMIT 50;

ranked_customers AS (

WITH product_sales AS (

ranked_products AS (

    FROM product_sales

            CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price

    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,

SELECT

            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, product_id
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.id AS product_id,
            p.name AS product_name,
            p.category,
            p.stock,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                    THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) AS revenue_2024,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                    THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) AS revenue_2023
        FROM products AS p
        LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.product_id = p.id
        LEFT JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.id = oi.order_id
           AND o.status = 'paid'
           AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
        GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock

    SELECT

        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS country_revenue_2024
    FROM category_performance
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 * 100.0 / NULLIF(country_revenue_2024, 0), 1)
        AS country_share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 2
  AND revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.stock,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers,
        AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_selling_price
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.category, p.id, p.name, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT

            PARTITION BY category
        ) AS category_revenue
    FROM product_sales

    category,

    product_id,
    product_name,
    units_sold,

    unique_customers,
    ROUND(avg_selling_price, 2) AS avg_selling_price,
    stock,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out of stock'
        WHEN stock < units_sold THEN 'replenishment risk'

FROM ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 10

WITH customer_year AS (

        o.order_year,

        c.signup_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS products_bought,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.category) AS category_mix
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id

WITH customer_spend AS (

        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN 1 END) AS orders_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.customer_id = c.id
     AND o.status = 'paid'

    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.is_active
),
category_breadth AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year = 2024
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        COALESCE(cb.categories_2024, 0) AS categories_2024,

            100.0 * (cs.spend_2024 - cs.spend_2023) / NULLIF(cs.spend_2023, 0),

        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.country

        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
grid AS (
    SELECT
        y.year,
        c.category,
        COALESCE(s.revenue, 0.0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(s.units_sold, 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(s.customers, 0) AS customers
    FROM years AS y
    CROSS JOIN categories AS c
    LEFT JOIN sales AS s
        ON s.year = y.year
       AND s.category = c.category
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        g.*,
        SUM(g.revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY g.year) AS yearly_revenue,
        LAG(g.revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY g.category
            ORDER BY g.year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY g.year
            ORDER BY g.revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM grid AS g
)
SELECT
    year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    units_sold,
    customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(yearly_revenue, 0), 2) AS share_of_yearly_revenue_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN prior_year_revenue IS NULL OR prior_year_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(
            100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / prior_year_revenue,
            2
        )
    END AS yoy_growth_pct,
    category_rank
FROM metrics
ORDER BY year, category_rank, category;

ranked AS (

  ),
  sales AS (
    SELECT
      c.country,
      p.category,
      o.order_year,
      SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
      COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyers,

    FROM orders AS o

    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year BETWEEN 2020 AND 2024
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category, o.order_year
  ),
  filled AS (
    SELECT
      c.country,
      cat.category,
      y.order_year,
      COALESCE(s.revenue, 0) AS revenue,
      COALESCE(s.buyers, 0) AS buyers,

    FROM countries AS c

     AND s.order_year = y.order_year
  ),
  trends AS (

      *,
      LAG(revenue) OVER (
        PARTITION BY country, category
        ORDER BY order_year
      ) AS previous_revenue

  country,
  category,

    ORDER BY revenue DESC

        ) AS category_rank,

    FROM category_year AS cy

        ON cy.customer_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customer_summary
)
SELECT
    name,
    city,
    country,
    signup_year,
    is_active,
    revenue_2023,
    revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    orders_2023,
    orders_2024,
    categories_2024,
    country_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,

    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id

    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
scored AS (
    SELECT

        category,
        revenue,
        orders,
        customers,

            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT

    category,

    orders,
    customers,
    units_sold,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(previous_revenue, 2) AS previous_revenue,
    ROUND(

FROM scored

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        c.country,
        c.is_active,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.total
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.total
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id
        END) AS paid_orders_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, c.is_active
),
customer_categories AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year = 2024
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        COALESCE(cc.categories_bought_2024, 0) AS categories_bought_2024,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.country
            ORDER BY cs.revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_revenue_rank
    FROM customer_spend AS cs
    LEFT JOIN customer_categories AS cc
        ON cc.customer_id = cs.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    country,
    is_active,
    revenue_2024,
    revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),

    ) AS growth_pct,
    paid_orders_2024,
    categories_bought_2024,
    country_revenue_rank
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        signup_year,
        country,
        COUNT(*) AS cohort_customers
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY signup_year, country
),
cohort_activity AS (
    SELECT
        c.signup_year,
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS retained_customers,
        COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders,
        SUM(o.total) AS revenue
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year >= c.signup_year
    GROUP BY c.signup_year, c.country, o.order_year
),
ranked_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        a.signup_year,
        a.country,
        a.order_year,
        a.order_year - a.signup_year AS years_since_signup,
        s.cohort_customers,
        a.retained_customers,
        a.paid_orders,
        ROUND(a.revenue, 2) AS revenue,
        ROUND(100.0 * a.retained_customers / s.cohort_customers, 2) AS retention_pct,
        ROUND(a.revenue / a.retained_customers, 2) AS revenue_per_retained_customer,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.order_year
            ORDER BY a.revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM cohort_activity AS a
    JOIN cohort_sizes AS s
      ON s.signup_year = a.signup_year
     AND s.country = a.country
)
SELECT
    signup_year,
    country,
    order_year,
    years_since_signup,
    cohort_customers,
    retained_customers,
    paid_orders,
    revenue,
    retention_pct,
    revenue_per_retained_customer,
    revenue_rank
FROM ranked_cohorts
ORDER BY revenue DESC, retention_pct DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        orders,
        customers,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank,
        100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
        ) AS revenue_share_pct,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    revenue_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_share_pct, 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
    orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(orders, 0), 2) AS average_order_value,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM scored
WHERE revenue_rank <= 2
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (
        PARTITION BY country, order_year
    ), 0), 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
    customers_count,
    revenue_rank,
    ROUND(prior_year_revenue, 2) AS prior_year_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) /
        NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        customers_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.country,
            o.order_year,
            p.category,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers_count
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.id = o.customer_id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY
            c.country,
            o.order_year,
            p.category
    ) AS category_sales
) AS ranked_sales
WHERE revenue_rank <= 2
ORDER BY order_year DESC, country, revenue_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue_all_years,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT
    name,
    category,
    category_rank,
    stock,
    units_sold,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    ROUND(revenue_all_years, 2) AS revenue_all_years,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'
        WHEN units_sold > stock THEN 'high_demand'
        ELSE 'adequate_stock'
    END AS inventory_signal
FROM ranked_products
WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_performance AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers_2024
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o

       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
        ) AS category_revenue_2024
    FROM product_performance
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    CASE
        WHEN revenue_2023 > 0
        THEN ROUND(100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / revenue_2023, 1)
    END AS yoy_growth_pct,
    units_2024,
    customers_2024,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(category_revenue_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS category_share_pct,
    stock,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'
        WHEN stock < units_2024 THEN 'replenishment_risk'
        ELSE 'healthy'
    END AS inventory_status
FROM ranked
ORDER BY revenue_2024

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        paid_orders,
        customers,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year) AS annual_revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(annual_revenue, 0), 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    category_rank
FROM metrics
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year, p.category
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        orders,
        customers,
        revenue * 1.0
            / SUM(revenue) OVER (
                PARTITION BY country, order_year
              ) AS country_year_share,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * country_year_share, 1) AS share_of_country_year_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM metrics
WHERE category_rank = 1
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    orders_count,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(prior_year_revenue, 2) AS prior_year_revenue,
    CASE
        WHEN prior_year_revenue IS NULL OR prior_year_revenue = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / prior_year_revenue, 1)
    END AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        orders_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.country,
            o.order_year,
            p.category,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders_count
        FROM customers AS c
        JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.customer_id = c.id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year, p.category
    ) AS category_sales
) AS ranked_sales
WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY order_year DESC, country, category_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT id, customer_id, order_year, total
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'paid'
),
customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(po.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_year) AS active_years,
        SUM(po.total) AS lifetime_spend,
        SUM(CASE WHEN po.order_year = 2024 THEN po.total ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN po.order_year < 2024 THEN po.total ELSE 0 END) AS spend_before_2024
    FROM customers c
    JOIN paid_orders po ON po.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.id
),
category_spend AS (
    SELECT
        po.customer_id,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS category_revenue
    FROM paid_orders po
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = po.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY po.customer_id, p.category
),
preferred_category AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        category,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY category_revenue DESC, category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_spend
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        pc.category AS preferred_category,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.country
            ORDER BY cs.spend_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_2024_rank
    FROM customer_spend cs
    JOIN preferred_category pc
      ON pc.customer_id = cs.customer_id
     AND pc.category_rank = 1
    WHERE cs.is_active = 1
      AND cs.paid_orders >= 2
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    country,
    city,
    signup_year,
    paid_orders,
    active_years,
    preferred_category,
    ROUND(lifetime_spend, 2) AS lifetime_spend,
    ROUND(spend_before_2024, 2) AS spend_before_2024,
    ROUND(spend_2024, 2) AS spend_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (spend_2024 - spend_before_2024 / NULLIF(active_years - 1, 0))
        / NULLIF(spend_before_2024 / NULLIF(active_years - 1, 0), 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_vs_prior_yearly_average_pct,
    country_2024_rank
FROM ranked_customers
ORDER BY spend_2024 DESC, lifetime_spend DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    order_count,
    customer_count,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        order_count,
        customer_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.country,
            o.order_year,
            p.category,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.id = o.customer_id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY
            c.country,
            o.order_year,
            p.category
    ) AS annual_category_sales
) AS ranked_sales
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY
    order_year DESC,
    country,
    category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.country,
        c.is_active,
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.order_year,
        oi.product_id,
        p.category,
        oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS revenue
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        name,
        country,
        is_active,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN order_id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN category END) AS categories_2024
    FROM paid_sales
    GROUP BY customer_id, name, country, is_active
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS category_spend_2024,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY
                SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) DESC,
                category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM paid_sales
    GROUP BY customer_id, category
)
SELECT
    m.customer_id,
    m.name,
    m.country,
    m.is_active,
    ROUND(m.spend_2023, 2) AS spend_2023,
    ROUND(m.spend_2024, 2) AS spend_2024,
    ROUND(m.spend_2024 - m.spend_2023, 2) AS spend_increase,
    CASE
        WHEN m.spend_2023 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (m.spend_2024 - m.spend_2023) / m.spend_2023, 1)
    END AS growth_pct,
    m.orders_2024,
    m.categories_2024,
    t.category AS favorite_category_2024,
    ROUND(t.category_spend_2024, 2) AS favorite_category_spend
FROM customer_metrics AS m
JOIN category_totals AS t
    ON t.customer_id = m.customer_id
   AND t.category_rank = 1
WHERE m.spend_2024 > m.spend_2023
ORDER BY spend_increase DESC, spend_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(COALESCE(o.total, 0)) AS revenue,
        COUNT(*) AS paid_orders
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_year
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.country,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.order_year = 2023 THEN a.revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.order_year = 2024 THEN a.revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.order_year = 2024 THEN a.paid_orders ELSE 0 END), 0) AS orders_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN annual AS a
        ON a.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country
),
category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        p.category,

),
favorite_category AS (
    SELECT

    FROM category_sales
),
ranked_customers AS (

        ) AS country_rank
    FROM metrics AS m

)
SELECT

customer_totals AS (

category_totals AS (

ranked AS (

SELECT

WITH category_year AS (

ranked AS (

        / NULLIF(paid_revenue + refunded_value, 0),

ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue_rank, category

ORDER BY revenue DESC, country, order_year, category

WITH paid_customer AS (

SELECT

customer_stats AS (

    FROM customers AS c

),
category_spend AS (

preferred_category AS (

),
ranked_customers AS (

        ) AS share_of_country_spend
    FROM customer_stats AS cs

SELECT

    country,
    city,
    signup_year,
    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    lifetime_spend,
    average_order_value,

    latest_order_year,
    active_order_years,

    country_rank,

ORDER BY lifetime_spend DESC

WITH category_year AS (

        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_bought,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE c.is_active = 1
    GROUP BY
        c.country,
        c.id,
        c.name,
        o.order_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS country_year_rank
    FROM customer_year
)
SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    country_year_rank,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    units_bought,
    categories_bought,
    ROUND(revenue / paid_orders, 2) AS average_order_value
FROM ranked
WHERE country_year_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year DESC, country, country_year_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (

ranked_products AS (

SELECT

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_active = 1 THEN c.id END) AS active_customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        paid_orders,
        customers,
        active_customers,
        revenue / NULLIF(paid_orders, 0) AS average_order_value,
        100.0 * active_customers / NULLIF(customers, 0) AS active_customer_pct,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(average_order_value, 2) AS average_order_value,
    ROUND(active_customer_pct, 1) AS active_customer_pct,
    ROUND(revenue - prior_year_revenue, 2) AS revenue_change,
    ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0), 1) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    category_rank
FROM scored
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT

        PARTITION BY country

    ) AS country_rank
FROM (
    SELECT

        c.country,

        c.is_active,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2023 AND o.status = 'paid'
                THEN o.total
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'

            END
        ), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE

            SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.category)

            JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
            WHERE o2.customer_id = c.id

        ) AS categories_2024
    FROM customers c
    LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, c.city, c.is_active
    HAVING SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN o.total
            ELSE 0

)
ORDER BY country_rank, country, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT

    product_id,
    name,
    units_sold,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    unique_customers,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(units_sold, 0), 2) AS avg_selling_price,
    stock,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue
        / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 0),
        1
    ) AS category_revenue_pct,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY category
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS category_rank,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 AND units_sold > 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'
        WHEN stock < units_sold * 0.25 AND units_sold > 0 THEN 'low_stock'
        WHEN units_sold = 0 THEN 'no_sales'
        ELSE 'healthy'
    END AS inventory_signal
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                 ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id END
        ) AS unique_customers
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.order_year BETWEEN 2022 AND 2024
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
)
ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC
LIMIT 50;

            WHEN COALESCE(a23.revenue, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(100.0 * (a24.revenue - a23.revenue) / a23.revenue, 1)
        END AS revenue_growth_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country
            ORDER BY a24.revenue DESC, a24.order_count DESC, c.id
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN annual AS a24
      ON a24.customer_id = c.id
     AND a24.order_year = 2024
    LEFT JOIN annual AS a23
      ON a23.customer_id = c.id
     AND a23.order_year = 2023
    LEFT JOIN categories AS cat
      ON cat.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE c.is_active = 1
)

    customer_id,
    name,
    city,

    FROM paid_orders
    GROUP BY customer_id

category_2024 AS (

    FROM paid_orders po

ranked AS (

        a.spend_2023,
        a.spend_2024,
        a.orders_2023,
        a.orders_2024,
        COALESCE(cat.categories_2024, 0) AS categories_2024,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * (a.spend_2024 - a.spend_2023) / NULLIF(a.spend_2023, 0),
            1
        ) AS growth_pct,
        ROUND(a.spend_2024 / NULLIF(a.orders_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value_2024,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country
            ORDER BY a.spend_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customers c
    JOIN annual_spend a ON a.customer_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN category_2024 cat ON cat.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE a.spend_2024 > a.spend_2023
      AND a.spend_2024 > 0

SELECT

WITH RECURSIVE

    SELECT 2019
    UNION ALL
    SELECT year + 1
    FROM years
    WHERE year < 2024
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        signup_year,
        COUNT(*) AS cohort_customers
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2024
    GROUP BY signup_year
),
cohort_activity AS (
    SELECT
        c.signup_year,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS buying_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) AS avg_order_value
    FROM customers c
    JOIN orders o
      ON o.customer_id = c.id
     AND o.status = 'paid'
     AND o.order_year >= c.signup_year
    WHERE c.signup_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2024
    GROUP BY c.signup_year, o.order_year
)
SELECT
    cs.signup_year AS cohort_year,
    y.year AS activity_year,
    cs.cohort_customers,
    COALESCE(ca.buying_customers, 0) AS buying_customers,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COALESCE(ca.buying_customers, 0) / cs.cohort_customers,
        1
    ) AS retention_pct,
    COALESCE(ca.paid_orders, 0) AS paid_orders,
    COALESCE(ca.revenue, 0) AS revenue,
    ca.avg_order_value
FROM cohort_sizes cs
JOIN years y
  ON y.year >= cs.signup_year
LEFT JOIN cohort_activity ca
  ON ca.signup_year = cs.signup_year
 AND ca.order_year = y.year
ORDER BY cs.signup_year, activity_year
LIMIT 50;

        COALESCE(SUM(CASE

            ELSE 0

        END) AS customers_2024
    FROM products p

        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
growing_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        revenue_2024 - revenue_2023 AS revenue_change,
        CASE
            WHEN revenue_2023 > 0

            ELSE NULL
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM product_year
    WHERE revenue_2024 > 0

ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY
                CASE WHEN revenue_2023 = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC,
                growth_rate DESC,
                revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM growing_products
)

    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,

            COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS unique_customers,
            SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.id = o.customer_id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY c.country, p.category
    )
)
WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    category,
    country,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(revenue / paid_orders, 2) AS avg_order_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 2) AS country_revenue_share_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        c.country,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.category, c.country
) AS category_country
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year, p.category
),
with_previous AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(order_year) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_revenue
    FROM category_sales
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        previous_revenue,
        orders,
        customers,
        revenue * 1.0
            / SUM(revenue) OVER (
                PARTITION BY country, order_year
              ) AS revenue_share,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM with_previous
    WHERE previous_year = order_year - 1
      AND previous_revenue > 0
)
SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(previous_revenue, 2) AS previous_year_revenue,
    ROUND((revenue - previous_revenue) * 100.0 / previous_revenue, 1) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND(revenue_share * 100.0, 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
    orders,
    customers,
    category_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY yoy_growth_pct DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    paid_revenue,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    stock,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * units_sold / NULLIF(units_sold + stock, 0),
        1
    ) AS sell_through_pct,
    category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        category,
        product_id,
        product_name,
        paid_revenue,
        units_sold,
        paid_orders,
        stock,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY paid_revenue DESC, units_sold DESC, product_id
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.category,
            p.id AS product_id,
            p.name AS product_name,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                    THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) AS paid_revenue,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                    THEN oi.quantity
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) AS units_sold,
            COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
                WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id
            END) AS paid_orders,
            p.stock
        FROM products AS p
        LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.product_id = p.id
        LEFT JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.id = oi.order_id
        GROUP BY
            p.category,
            p.id,
            p.name,
            p.stock
    )
)
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        o.id AS order_id,
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.is_active,
        oi.quantity,

    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2023,
        ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN order_id END) AS orders_2024,

            1
        ) AS active_customer_pct
    FROM sales

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),

        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM summary
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    revenue_2023,
    revenue_2024,
    yoy_growth_pct,
    units_2024,
    orders_2024,
    customers_2024,

    revenue_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 50
ORDER BY revenue_rank, country, category;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,

),
ranked AS (

        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,

    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(

            WHEN revenue_2023 > 0

        END,
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    orders_2024,
    customers,
    units_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 / NULLIF(orders_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value_2024
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id

),
ranked AS (

    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,

    ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM ranked

ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank, revenue DESC

SELECT
    order_year,

    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),

    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,

FROM (

WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.is_active,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.is_active
),
category_breadth AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year = 2024
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        cm.*,
        COALESCE(cb.categories_bought_2024, 0) AS categories_bought_2024,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cm.country
            ORDER BY cm.revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_revenue_rank
    FROM customer_metrics AS cm
    LEFT JOIN category_breadth AS cb
        ON cb.customer_id = cm.customer_id
    WHERE cm.revenue_2024 > 0
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    name,
    city,
    country,
    is_active,
    revenue_2023,
    revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    orders_2023,
    orders_2024,
    categories_bought_2024,
    country_revenue_rank
FROM ranked_customers
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, categories_bought_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,

    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
scored AS (

SELECT

    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,

ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue_rank, category

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        revenue_2024 * 1.0
            / SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_revenue_share
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT

    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,

        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023)

    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,

    ROUND(100.0 * country_revenue_share, 1) AS country_revenue_share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 2
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC;

WITH country_category AS (

        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price

                WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2023

    FROM customers AS c

ranked AS (

SELECT

    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(country_revenue_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS country_share_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, country, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH yearly_category AS (

        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,

    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id

),
ranked AS (
    SELECT

        revenue,

            / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year), 0) AS revenue_share,

            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM yearly_category
)
SELECT

        (revenue - previous_year_revenue) * 100.0

        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,

FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank, category;

WITH paid_sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
),
customer_year AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS spend_2024
    FROM paid_sales
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
category_2024 AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        category,
        SUM(revenue) AS category_spend
    FROM paid_sales
    WHERE order_year = 2024
    GROUP BY customer_id, category
),
ranked_categories AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        category,
        category_spend,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY category_spend DESC, category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_2024
)
SELECT
    c.id AS customer_id,
    c.name,
    c.country,
    c.is_active,
    ROUND(cy.spend_2023, 2) AS spend_2023,
    ROUND(cy.spend_2024, 2) AS spend_2024,
    ROUND(cy.spend_2024 - cy.spend_2023, 2) AS absolute_growth,
    ROUND(100.0 * (cy.spend_2024 - cy.spend_2023) / cy.spend_2023, 1) AS growth_percent,
    rc.category AS leading_2024_category,
    ROUND(rc.category_spend, 2) AS leading_category_spend,
    ROUND(100.0 * rc.category_spend / cy.spend_2024, 1) AS leading_category_share_percent
FROM customers AS c
JOIN customer_year AS cy ON cy.customer_id = c.id
JOIN ranked_categories AS rc
  ON rc.customer_id = c.id
 AND rc.category_rank = 1
WHERE cy.spend_2023 > 0
  AND cy.spend_2024 > cy.spend_2023
ORDER BY absolute_growth DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH yearly_category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_active = 1 THEN c.id END) AS active_customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
with_previous_year AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue
    FROM yearly_category_sales
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    active_customers,
    ROUND(100.0 * active_customers / NULLIF(customers, 0), 1) AS active_customer_pct
FROM with_previous_year
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id END) AS unique_customers
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        ps.*,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        revenue * 1.0 / NULLIF(
            SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 0
        ) AS category_revenue_share,
        units_sold * 1.0 / NULLIF(stock + units_sold, 0) AS sell_through_rate
    FROM product_sales AS ps
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    category,
    revenue,
    units_sold,
    unique_customers,
    stock,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(category_revenue_share * 100, 2) AS category_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(sell_through_rate * 100, 2) AS sell_through_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 AND units_sold > 0 THEN 'out of stock'
        WHEN stock > 0 AND units_sold >= stock * 2 THEN 'replenish soon'
        WHEN units_sold = 0 THEN 'no paid sales'
        ELSE 'healthy'
    END AS inventory_signal
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue > 0
ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (

        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024

    JOIN customers AS c

ranked AS (

WITH years(year) AS (
    VALUES (2019), (2020), (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024)
),
categories(category) AS (
    VALUES ('kitchen'), ('garden'), ('office'), ('sport'), ('toys')
),
category_year AS (
    SELECT
        y.year,
        c.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id END) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN cu.id END) AS customers,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_sold
    FROM years y
    CROSS JOIN categories c
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON p.category = c.category
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.order_year = y.year
    LEFT JOIN customers cu
        ON cu.id = o.customer_id
    GROUP BY y.year, c.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    year,
    category,

FROM ranked

WITH segment AS (

),
scored AS (

WITH customer_metrics AS (

category_metrics AS (

ranked_customers AS (

    FROM customer_metrics AS cm
    LEFT JOIN category_metrics AS cat

            COALESCE(cs.products_bought, 0) AS products_bought
        FROM customers AS c
        JOIN (
            SELECT
                customer_id,
                COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
                COUNT(DISTINCT order_year) AS years_with_orders,
                MAX(order_year) AS latest_order_year,
                SUM(total) AS total_spend,
                AVG(total) AS avg_order_value
            FROM orders
            WHERE status = 'paid'
            GROUP BY customer_id
        ) AS os
            ON os.customer_id = c.id
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                o.customer_id,
                COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought,
                COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS products_bought
            FROM orders AS o
            JOIN order_items AS oi
                ON oi.order_id = o.id
            JOIN products AS p
                ON p.id = oi.product_id
            WHERE o.status = 'paid'
            GROUP BY o.customer_id
        ) AS cs
            ON cs.customer_id = c.id
        WHERE os.paid_orders >= 2
    ) AS customer_metrics
) AS ranked_customers
WHERE country_spend_rank <= 3
ORDER BY total_spend DESC, paid_orders DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
