        ly.year AS latest_year,
        COALESCE(SUM(ps.revenue), 0) AS lifetime_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.order_year = ly.year
                          THEN ps.revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS latest_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.order_year = ly.year - 1
                          THEN ps.revenue ELSE 0 END), 0) AS prior_year_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ps.order_id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ps.order_year = ly.year
                            THEN ps.order_id END) AS latest_year_orders
    FROM products AS p
    CROSS JOIN latest_year AS ly
    LEFT JOIN paid_sales AS ps
      ON ps.product_id = p.id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock, ly.year
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        pm.*,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY latest_revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        100.0 * latest_revenue
        / NULLIF(SUM(latest_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 0)
            AS category_revenue_share
    FROM product_metrics AS pm
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,
    latest_year,
    ROUND(latest_revenue, 2) AS latest_year_revenue,
    ROUND(prior_year_revenue, 2) AS prior_year_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (latest_revenue - prior_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    ROUND(category_revenue_share, 1) AS category_revenue_share_pct,
    latest_year_orders,
    paid_orders AS lifetime_paid_orders,
    stock,
    price
FROM ranked_products
WHERE latest_revenue > 0
ORDER BY latest_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH customer_stats AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.country,
        c.city,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(o.total), 2) AS average_order_value,
        MAX(o.order_year) AS latest_order_year
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, c.city, c.is_active
),
category_breadth AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_purchased
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        COALESCE(cb.categories_purchased, 0) AS categories_purchased,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.country
            ORDER BY cs.revenue DESC
        ) AS country_rank,
        SUM(cs.revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.country
        ) AS country_revenue
    FROM customer_stats AS cs
    LEFT JOIN category_breadth AS cb
        ON cb.customer_id = cs.customer_id
)
SELECT
    country,
    country_rank,
    name,
    city,
    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    revenue,
    average_order_value,
    categories_purchased,
    latest_order_year,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(country_revenue, 0), 2) AS share_of_country_revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, country_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category,
    price,
    stock,
    paid_revenue,
    units_sold,
    paying_customers,
    paid_orders,
    refunded_value,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * refunded_value
        / NULLIF(paid_revenue + refunded_value, 0),
        2
    ) AS refund_rate_pct,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY category
        ORDER BY paid_revenue DESC
    ) AS category_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * paid_revenue
        / NULLIF(SUM(paid_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 0),
        2
    ) AS category_revenue_share_pct,
    stock * price AS current_inventory_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                 ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS paid_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid'
                 THEN oi.quantity
                 ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS paying_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id
        END) AS paid_orders,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded'
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                 ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS refunded_value
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock
) AS product_metrics
WHERE paid_revenue > 0
ORDER BY paid_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.category, o.order_year
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        order_year,
        revenue,
        units_sold,
        order_count,
        customer_count,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    category,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    revenue_rank,
    units_sold,
    order_count,
    customer_count,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM scored
ORDER BY order_year, revenue_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_performance AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                          THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                          THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                            THEN o.customer_id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC, units_2024 DESC, product_id
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_performance
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    stock,
    units_2024,
    customers_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out of stock'
        WHEN stock <= units_2024 THEN 'restock urgently'
        WHEN stock <= 2 * units_2024 THEN 'monitor stock'
        ELSE 'healthy stock'
    END AS inventory_signal
FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH order_category AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category, o.id, o.customer_id
),
category_year AS (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        SUM(revenue) AS revenue,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers
    FROM order_category
    GROUP BY order_year, category
),
with_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        cy.*,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
        ) AS yearly_revenue
    FROM category_year AS cy
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(yearly_revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue_share_pct,
    order_count,
    customers,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_order,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS category_rank
FROM with_metrics
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders,
        SUM(o.total) AS revenue,
        AVG(o.total) AS average_order_value,
        MAX(o.order_year) AS last_order_year
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, c.id, c.name
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS country_rank,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS country_revenue
    FROM customer_spend
)
SELECT
    country,
    country_rank,
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    paid_orders,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(average_order_value, 2) AS average_order_value,
    last_order_year,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(country_revenue, 0), 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, country_rank, customer_name
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        o.total,
        c.is_active
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
),
annual AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_active = 1 THEN customer_id END) AS active_customers,
        ROUND(SUM(total), 2) AS revenue,
        ROUND(AVG(total), 2) AS average_order_value
    FROM paid_orders
    GROUP BY country, order_year
),
category_mix AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_purchased
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        COALESCE(m.categories_purchased, 0) AS categories_purchased,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.order_year
            ORDER BY a.revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank,
        LAG(a.revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY a.country
            ORDER BY a.order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue
    FROM annual AS a
    LEFT JOIN category_mix AS m
        ON m.country = a.country
       AND m.order_year = a.order_year
)
SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    revenue_rank,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    active_customers,
    categories_purchased,
    revenue,
    average_order_value,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM ranked
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue_rank, country
LIMIT 50;

WITH
years(year) AS (
    VALUES (2019), (2020), (2021), (2022), (2023), (2024)
),
countries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country
    FROM customers
),
categories AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT category
    FROM products
),
grid AS (
    SELECT c.country, y.year, p.category
    FROM countries c
    CROSS JOIN years y
    CROSS JOIN categories p
),
annual_sales AS (
    SELECT
        g.country,
        g.year,
        g.category,
        COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS revenue
    FROM grid g
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON c.country = g.country
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.order_year = g.year
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
       AND p.category = g.category
    GROUP BY g.country, g.year, g.category
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        year,
        category,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, year
        ) AS country_revenue,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM annual_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    revenue AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(country_revenue, 0), 1) AS share_of_country_revenue_pct,
    prior_year_revenue AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    category_rank
FROM metrics
WHERE year = 2024
  AND category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    unique_customers,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(paid_orders, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_order,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_revenue) / NULLIF(previous_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS revenue_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        order_year,
        category,
        revenue,
        paid_orders,
        unique_customers,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            o.order_year,
            p.category,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
    ) AS category_year
) AS trends
ORDER BY order_year, revenue_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS unique_buyers
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        ps.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC, name
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
        ) AS category_revenue
    FROM product_sales AS ps
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS paid_revenue,
    units_sold,
    unique_buyers,
    stock,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(category_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS category_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * units_sold / NULLIF(units_sold + stock, 0),
        3
    ) AS sell_through_rate
FROM ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
        ) AS total_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(total_year_revenue, 0), 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(paid_orders, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_order
FROM metrics
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year DESC, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id

),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue,
        paid_orders,
        customers,
        units_sold,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
        ) AS revenue_share_pct
    FROM category_sales
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    units_sold,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_share_pct, 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_country_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers,

    FROM orders AS o

    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id

ranked AS (
    SELECT

        category,

        units_sold,
        ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(paid_orders, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_order,
        ROUND(

            2
        ) AS country_category_share,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_country_sales

SELECT

    category,
    revenue,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    units_sold,
    revenue_per_order,
    country_category_share,

WITH country_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.total ELSE 0 END) AS paid_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id END) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id END) AS paying_customers,

ranked AS (

        order_year,

        paying_customers,

        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY paid_revenue DESC
        ) AS country_rank,
        LAG(paid_revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue
    FROM country_year
)
SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    country_rank,
    ROUND(paid_revenue, 2) AS paid_revenue,
    paid_orders,
    paying_customers,
    active_paying_customers,
    ROUND(paid_revenue / NULLIF(paid_orders, 0), 2) AS average_order_value,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (paid_revenue - prior_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM ranked
WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year DESC, country_rank, country
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.id AS order_id,
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        o.total
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
),
customer_year_orders AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        order_year,
        COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
        SUM(total) AS revenue
    FROM paid_orders
    GROUP BY customer_id, order_year
),
customer_year_categories AS (
    SELECT
        po.customer_id,
        po.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM paid_orders AS po
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = po.order_id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY po.customer_id, po.order_year
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        c.country,
        cyo.order_year,
        cyo.paid_orders,
        ROUND(cyo.revenue, 2) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(cyc.categories_bought, 0) AS categories_bought,
        ROUND(cyo.revenue / NULLIF(cyo.paid_orders, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value,
        LAG(cyo.revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.id
            ORDER BY cyo.order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country, cyo.order_year
            ORDER BY cyo.revenue DESC
        ) AS country_year_rank
    FROM customer_year_orders AS cyo
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = cyo.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN customer_year_categories AS cyc
        ON cyc.customer_id = cyo.customer_id
       AND cyc.order_year = cyo.order_year
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    country,
    order_year,
    paid_orders,
    revenue,
    avg_order_value,
    categories_bought,
    country_year_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_revenue_change_pct
FROM metrics
ORDER BY revenue DESC, order_year DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                 THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                            THEN o.customer_id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,
    units_2024,
    customers_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) * 100.0
        / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    stock
FROM ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH annual AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY
        c.id,
        c.name,
        c.country,
        o.order_year
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS country_year_rank
    FROM annual
)
SELECT
    customer_name,
    country,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    paid_orders,
    distinct_products,
    categories_bought,
    country_year_rank,
    ROUND(prior_year_revenue, 2) AS prior_year_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS year_over_year_growth_pct
FROM scored
ORDER BY revenue DESC, order_year DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH annual_country_sales AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        c.country,
        SUM(o.total) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_active = 1 THEN c.id END) AS active_customer_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, c.country
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
        ) AS year_total_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC, country
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM annual_country_sales
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    revenue_rank,
    country,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(year_total_revenue, 0), 2) AS share_of_year_pct,
    order_count,
    customer_count,
    active_customer_count,
    ROUND(revenue * 1.0 / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 2) AS average_order_value,
    ROUND(prior_year_revenue, 2) AS prior_year_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM metrics
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_year, revenue_rank
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    category,
    customers_2024,
    orders_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 / NULLIF(orders_2024, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value_2024,
    category_rank_in_country
FROM (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END) AS revenue_2023,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.country
            ORDER BY
                SUM(CASE
                    WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                    THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                    ELSE 0
                END) DESC
        ) AS category_rank_in_country
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category
)
WHERE category_rank_in_country <= 2
ORDER BY country, category_rank_in_country;

SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    unique_customers,
    revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(category_revenue, 0), 2) AS category_revenue_pct,
    category_rank,
    stock,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 THEN 'out of stock'
        WHEN stock < units_sold THEN 'at risk'
        ELSE 'adequate'
    END AS inventory_status
FROM (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        product_name,
        category,
        units_sold,
        paid_orders,
        unique_customers,
        revenue,
        stock,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS category_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.id AS product_id,
            p.name AS product_name,
            p.category,
            p.stock,
            SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
        FROM products AS p
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.product_id = p.id
        JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.id = oi.order_id
           AND o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY
            p.id,
            p.name,
            p.category,
            p.stock
    )
)
WHERE category_rank <= 10
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    country,
    order_year,
    paid_orders,
    paying_customers,
    revenue,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(paid_orders, 0), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    country_rank,
    ROUND(revenue - previous_year_revenue, 2) AS revenue_change,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        order_year,
        paid_orders,
        paying_customers,
        revenue,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.country,
            o.order_year,
            COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS paying_customers,
            ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS revenue
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.id = o.customer_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year
    ) AS yearly_country_sales
) AS ranked_sales
ORDER BY order_year, country_rank, country
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    units_sold,
    orders,
    customers,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS yearly_category_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue
        / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year), 0),
        2
    ) AS share_of_yearly_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (
            revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (
                PARTITION BY category
                ORDER BY order_year
            )
        ) / NULLIF(
            LAG(revenue) OVER (
                PARTITION BY category
                ORDER BY order_year
            ),
            0
        ),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM category_year
ORDER BY order_year, yearly_category_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH country_year AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        c.country,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,
        AVG(o.total) AS avg_order_total
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2024
    GROUP BY o.order_year, c.country
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS revenue_rank
    FROM country_year
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    country,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    orders,
    customers,
    ROUND(avg_order_total, 2) AS avg_order_total,
    revenue_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM metrics
ORDER BY order_year, revenue_rank, country
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.country, p.category, o.order_year
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN buyers ELSE 0 END) AS buyers_2024
    FROM category_year
    GROUP BY country, category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        revenue_2023,
        revenue_2024,
        buyers_2024,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        revenue_2024 * 1.0
            / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 0)
            AS share_of_country_revenue
    FROM summary
)
SELECT
    country,
    category,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2024 - revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_change,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023)
        / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * share_of_country_revenue, 1) AS country_share_pct,
    buyers_2024
FROM ranked
ORDER BY category_rank, country, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH order_item_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COUNT(po.id) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(po.total), 0), 2) AS paid_revenue,
        ROUND(
            COALESCE(SUM(po.total) / NULLIF(COUNT(po.id), 0), 0),
            2
        ) AS average_order_value,
        COALESCE(SUM(oim.units), 0) AS units_purchased,
        COALESCE(SUM(oim.categories), 0) AS category_occurrences,
        COUNT(DISTINCT po.order_year) AS active_order_years,
        MAX(po.order_year) AS last_order_year
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN orders AS po
        ON po.customer_id = c.id
       AND po.status = 'paid'
    LEFT JOIN order_item_metrics AS oim
        ON oim.order_id = po.id
    GROUP BY
        c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country,
        c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        cm.*,
        ROUND(
            CAST(cm.paid_revenue AS REAL)
            / NULLIF(cm.signup_year - 2018, 0),
            2
        ) AS revenue_per_signup_year,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cm.country
            ORDER BY cm.paid_revenue DESC,
                     cm.paid_orders DESC,
                     cm.customer_id
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customer_metrics AS cm
    WHERE cm.paid_orders > 0
)
SELECT
    country_rank,
    customer_id,
    name,
    city,
    country,
    signup_year,
    is_active,
    paid_orders,
    paid_revenue,
    average_order_value,
    units_purchased,
    category_occurrences,
    active_order_years,
    last_order_year,
    revenue_per_signup_year
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE country_rank <= 10
ORDER BY country, country_rank
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customer_count
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.category, o.order_year
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        category,
        order_year,
        revenue,
        order_count,
        customer_count,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
        ) AS total_year_revenue
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    category,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    order_count,
    customer_count,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 2) AS average_order_value,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(total_year_revenue, 0), 1) AS share_of_year_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM enriched
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM order_items AS oi
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, o.order_year
),
product_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        product_name,
        category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2023 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        SUM(CASE WHEN order_year = 2024 THEN revenue ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024
    FROM product_sales
    GROUP BY product_id, product_name, category
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
        ) AS category_revenue_2024
    FROM product_comparison
    WHERE revenue_2024 > 0
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    product_name,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(category_revenue_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS category_share_pct
FROM ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2023 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.order_year = 2024 AND o.status = 'paid'
            THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers_2024
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
    category,
    category_rank,
    name AS product,
    revenue_2024,
    revenue_2023,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    units_2024,
    customers_2024,
    stock,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * stock / NULLIF(units_2024, 0),
        1
    ) AS stock_to_2024_units_ratio
FROM ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC;

SELECT
    product_id,
    product_name,
    category,
    units_sold,
    revenue,
    customers_reached,
    active_customers_reached,
    stock,
    revenue / NULLIF(units_sold, 0) AS realized_unit_price,
    category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers_reached,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.is_active = 1 THEN c.id END) AS active_customers_reached,
        p.stock,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.category
            ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year BETWEEN 2023 AND 2024
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
) AS ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH product_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.price,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lifetime_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue_2024
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.price, p.stock
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        RANK() OVER (
            ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC
        ) AS overall_rank
    FROM product_metrics
)
SELECT
    overall_rank,
    category_rank,
    name,
    category,
    units_sold,
    ROUND(lifetime_revenue, 2) AS lifetime_revenue,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_2024_vs_2023_pct,
    stock,
    ROUND(stock * price, 2) AS inventory_value
FROM ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 5
  AND overall_rank <= 50
ORDER BY overall_rank;

SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    units_sold_2024,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue_2024 / NULLIF(category_revenue_2024, 0),
        2
    ) AS category_share_pct,
    stock,
    rank_2024
FROM (
    SELECT
        product_data.*,
        SUM(revenue_2024) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
        ) AS category_revenue_2024,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
        ) AS rank_2024
    FROM (
        SELECT
            p.category,
            p.id AS product_id,
            p.name AS product_name,
            p.stock,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2023
                    THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) AS revenue_2023,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2024
                    THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) AS revenue_2024,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_year = 2024
                    THEN oi.quantity
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0) AS units_sold_2024
        FROM products AS p
        LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.product_id = p.id
        LEFT JOIN orders AS o
            ON o.id = oi.order_id
        GROUP BY
            p.id,
            p.category,
            p.name,
            p.stock
    ) AS product_data
) AS ranked_products
WHERE rank_2024 <= 3
ORDER BY
    category,
    rank_2024,
    revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        o.order_year,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS customers,

    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id

    GROUP BY p.category, o.order_year
),
scored AS (
    SELECT

        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS prior_year_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS year_rank
    FROM category_year
)
SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    orders,
    customers,
    avg_unit_price,
    ROUND(prior_year_revenue, 2) AS prior_year_revenue,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue)

        1
    ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
    year_rank
FROM scored
WHERE year_rank <= 5
ORDER BY order_year, year_rank, category
LIMIT 50;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name,
        c.city,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        c.is_active,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS spend_2024,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS spend_2023,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
       AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.city, c.country, c.signup_year, c.is_active
),
category_breadth AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_2024
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year = 2024
    GROUP BY o.customer_id
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        cs.*,
        COALESCE(cb.categories_2024, 0) AS categories_2024,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * (cs.spend_2024 - cs.spend_2023) / NULLIF(cs.spend_2023, 0),
            1
        ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cs.country
            ORDER BY cs.spend_2024 DESC
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customer_spend AS cs
    LEFT JOIN category_breadth AS cb
        ON cb.customer_id = cs.customer_id
)
SELECT
    country,
    country_rank,
    name,
    city,
    is_active,
    orders_2024,
    ROUND(spend_2024, 2) AS spend_2024,
    ROUND(spend_2023, 2) AS spend_2023,
    yoy_growth_pct,
    categories_2024
FROM ranked_customers
WHERE country_rank <= 3
  AND spend_2024 > 0
ORDER BY country, country_rank, spend_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH segment AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,

        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,

metrics AS (

            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS year_rank,

            PARTITION BY country, category

SELECT

SELECT

WITH category_sales AS (

ranked_customers AS (

WITH category_year AS (

scored AS (

WITH product_sales AS (

WITH paid_orders AS (

customer_metrics AS (

category_metrics AS (

ranked AS (

    FROM customer_metrics AS cm
    LEFT JOIN category_metrics AS cat

)
SELECT

    name,
    city,
    country,
    is_active,

    categories_bought,
    lifetime_spend,

    spend_2023,
    spend_2024,
    spend_change_2024_vs_2023,

FROM ranked
WHERE country_spend_rank <= 5
ORDER BY lifetime_spend DESC, country, name
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (

ranked AS (

SELECT

WITH category_stats AS (

scored AS (

comparison AS (

metrics AS (
    SELECT

            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue,

            / SUM(revenue) OVER (
                PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ) AS country_revenue_share_pct,

            PARTITION BY country, order_year

        JOIN products AS p

WITH category_sales AS (

    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id

    GROUP BY c.country, o.order_year, p.category
),
metrics AS (

        ) AS country_year_revenue,

SELECT
    category,
    name AS product,
    stock,
    units_sold,
    ROUND(lifetime_revenue, 2) AS lifetime_revenue,
    ROUND(revenue_2023, 2) AS revenue_2023,
    ROUND(revenue_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024,
    ROUND(
        (revenue_2024 - revenue_2023) * 100.0 / NULLIF(revenue_2023, 0),
        1
    ) AS growth_pct,
    ROUND(units_sold * 1.0 / NULLIF(stock, 0), 2) AS sales_to_stock_ratio,
    paid_orders,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY category
        ORDER BY revenue_2024 DESC
    ) AS category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.category,
        p.name,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END
        ), 0) AS units_sold,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END
        ), 0.0) AS lifetime_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL AND o.order_year = 2023
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0.0) AS revenue_2023,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN o.id IS NOT NULL AND o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0.0) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.category, p.name, p.stock
) AS product_metrics
ORDER BY category_rank, category, revenue_2024 DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH customer_metrics AS (

        c.country,
        c.signup_year,

        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought,
        MAX(o.order_year) AS latest_order_year
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, c.signup_year
),
country_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(paid_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_revenue
    FROM customer_metrics
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY paid_revenue DESC, paid_orders DESC, customer_id
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM country_totals

SELECT
    country,
    country_rank,
    name,
    signup_year,
    paid_orders,
    paid_revenue,
    ROUND(paid_revenue / paid_orders, 2) AS avg_paid_order_value,
    items_purchased,
    categories_bought,
    latest_order_year,
    ROUND(100.0 * paid_revenue / country_revenue, 1) AS share_of_country_revenue

WHERE country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY country, country_rank;

WITH customer_years AS (

SELECT

    city,
    country,

ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, spend_2024 DESC

WITH category_sales AS (

scored AS (

WITH customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.name,
        c.country,

        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN COALESCE(o.total, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024
    FROM customers AS c

),
category_mix AS (

),
ranked AS (

SELECT

    country_rank
FROM ranked

  AND revenue_2024 > revenue_2023
  AND country_rank <= 3
ORDER BY growth_pct DESC, revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH category_year AS (

scored AS (

SELECT

WITH customer_metrics AS (

ranked_customers AS (

WITH product_sales AS (

ranked AS (

SELECT

FROM ranked
WHERE category_rank <= 3

ORDER BY category, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC

WITH category_year AS (
    SELECT
        p.category,

    FROM orders AS o

scored AS (

SELECT

        100.0 * (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_year_revenue, 0),

    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,

SELECT
    country,
    category,
    order_year,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    order_count,
    customer_count,
    ROUND(revenue / NULLIF(order_count, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_order,

        100.0 * revenue
        / NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year), 0),
        2
    ) AS yearly_revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - previous_year_revenue)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_revenue, 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS yearly_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        category,
        order_year,
        revenue,
        order_count,

        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ) AS previous_year_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            c.country,
            p.category,
            o.order_year,
            SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customer_count
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.id = o.customer_id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY
            c.country,
            p.category,
            o.order_year
    )
)
WHERE order_year >= 2020
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    paid_revenue,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    stock,
    ROUND(CAST(units_sold AS REAL) / NULLIF(stock, 0), 2) AS sales_to_stock_ratio,
    category_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.category,
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS paid_revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        p.stock,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.category
            ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC, p.id
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM products AS p
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
) AS ranked_products
WHERE category_rank <= 3
ORDER BY category, category_rank;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity
            ELSE 0
        END), 0) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.id
        END) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS customers
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.category, p.stock
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS category_rank,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
        ) AS category_revenue
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT
    id,
    name,
    category,
    ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    customers,
    stock,
    category_rank,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN category_revenue > 0
            THEN 100.0 * revenue / category_revenue
            ELSE 0
        END,
        2
    ) AS category_revenue_pct,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN stock > 0 THEN 1.0 * units_sold / stock
            ELSE NULL
        END,
        2
    ) AS units_sold_per_current_stock,
    CASE
        WHEN stock = 0 AND units_sold > 0 THEN 'out_of_stock'
        WHEN stock > 0 AND 1.0 * units_sold / stock >= 2 THEN 'high_demand'
        WHEN stock > 0 AND 1.0 * units_sold / stock >= 1 THEN 'watch'
        ELSE 'normal'
    END AS inventory_signal
FROM ranked
ORDER BY revenue DESC, units_sold DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
    order_year,
    category,
    revenue,
    order_count,
    unique_customers,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY order_year
        ORDER BY revenue DESC
    ) AS category_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * revenue
        / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY order_year),
        2
    ) AS revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ))
        / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY category
            ORDER BY order_year
        ), 0),
        2
    ) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM (
    SELECT
        o.order_year,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.order_year, p.category
)
ORDER BY order_year DESC, revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH yearly_spend AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS revenue
    FROM orders AS o
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_year
),
yearly_categories AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) AS distinct_products,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS distinct_categories,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_year
),
customer_years AS (
    SELECT
        c.name,
        c.country,
        c.signup_year,
        s.order_year,
        s.paid_orders,
        s.revenue,
        COALESCE(cat.distinct_products, 0) AS distinct_products,
        COALESCE(cat.distinct_categories, 0) AS distinct_categories,
        COALESCE(cat.categories, '') AS categories,
        LAG(s.revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.customer_id
            ORDER BY s.order_year
        ) AS prior_revenue
    FROM yearly_spend AS s
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = s.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN yearly_categories AS cat
        ON cat.customer_id = s.customer_id
       AND cat.order_year = s.order_year
    WHERE c.is_active = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(
            100.0 * (revenue - prior_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_revenue, 0),
            1
        ) AS revenue_growth_pct,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country, order_year
            ORDER BY revenue DESC
        ) AS country_year_rank
    FROM customer_years
)
SELECT
    name,
    country,
    signup_year,
    order_year,
    paid_orders,
    revenue,
    prior_revenue,
    revenue_growth_pct,
    distinct_products,
    distinct_categories,
    categories,
    country_year_rank
FROM ranked
ORDER BY revenue DESC, order_year DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        c.country,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(*) AS paid_orders,
        ROUND(SUM(o.total), 2) AS annual_spend,

    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country, o.order_year
),
category_mix AS (
    SELECT
        o.customer_id,
        o.order_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS categories_bought,
        GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.category) AS category_mix
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY o.customer_id, o.order_year
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        y.*,
        cm.categories_bought,
        cm.category_mix,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY y.country, y.order_year
            ORDER BY y.annual_spend DESC
        ) AS country_year_rank,
        LAG(y.annual_spend) OVER (
            PARTITION BY y.customer_id
            ORDER BY y.order_year
        ) AS previous_year_spend
    FROM yearly AS y
    LEFT JOIN category_mix AS cm
        ON cm.customer_id = y.customer_id
       AND cm.order_year = y.order_year
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    customer_name,
    country,
    order_year,
    paid_orders,
    annual_spend,
    avg_order_value,
    categories_bought,
    category_mix,
    country_year_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (annual_spend - previous_year_spend)
        / NULLIF(previous_year_spend, 0),
        1
    ) AS yoy_spend_growth_pct
FROM ranked
ORDER BY annual_spend DESC, order_year DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH paid_lines AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS customer_id,
        c.name AS customer_name,
        c.country,
        o.id AS order_id,
        p.category,
        oi.quantity * oi.unit_price AS revenue
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.customer_id = c.id
       AND o.status = 'paid'
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.id = oi.product_id
),
customer_totals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        customer_name,
        country,
        SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS paid_orders
    FROM paid_lines
    GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name, country
),
category_totals AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        category,
        SUM(revenue) AS category_revenue
    FROM paid_lines
    GROUP BY customer_id, category
),
top_categories AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        category,
        category_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY category_revenue DESC, category
        ) AS category_rank
    FROM category_totals
),
ranked_customers AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_id
        ) AS country_rank
    FROM customer_totals
)
SELECT
    r.country,
    r.country_rank,
    r.customer_id,
    r.customer_name,
    r.paid_orders,
    ROUND(r.total_revenue, 2) AS total_revenue,
    ROUND(r.total_revenue / r.paid_orders, 2) AS average_order_value,
    t.category AS favorite_category,
    ROUND(t.category_revenue, 2) AS favorite_category_revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * t.category_revenue / r.total_revenue, 1) AS favorite_category_share_pct
FROM ranked_customers AS r
JOIN top_categories AS t
    ON t.customer_id = r.customer_id
   AND t.category_rank = 1
WHERE r.country_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.country, r.country_rank;

WITH category_sales AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.category,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2024,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2023 THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2023,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN o.id END) AS orders_2024,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN c.id END) AS customers_2024
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
      AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)

SELECT

    category,
    net_revenue,
    net_units_sold,
    unique_customers,
    ROUND(avg_realized_unit_price, 2) AS avg_realized_unit_price,
    stock,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY category
        ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
    ) AS category_rank,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * net_revenue
        / NULLIF(SUM(net_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 0),
        2
    ) AS category_revenue_share_pct,
    ROUND(
        1.0 * net_units_sold / NULLIF(stock, 0),
        2
    ) AS units_sold_per_stock_unit
FROM (
    SELECT
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.category,
        p.stock,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN -oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS net_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN o.status = 'paid' THEN oi.quantity
                WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN -oi.quantity
                ELSE 0
            END
        ), 0) AS net_units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded') THEN o.customer_id
        END) AS unique_customers,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded') THEN oi.unit_price
        END) AS avg_realized_unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.product_id = p.id
    LEFT JOIN orders AS o
        ON o.id = oi.order_id
       AND o.order_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2024
    GROUP BY
        p.id,
        p.name,
        p.category,
        p.stock
) AS product_metrics
ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
LIMIT 50;

            END) AS customers_2024,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024 THEN oi.quantity
                ELSE 0
            END), 0) AS units_2024,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2024
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END), 0) AS revenue_2024,
            COALESCE(SUM(CASE
                WHEN o.order_year = 2023
                THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price
                ELSE 0
            END), 0) AS revenue_2023
        FROM orders AS o
        JOIN customers AS c
            ON c.id = o.customer_id
        JOIN order_items AS oi
            ON oi.order_id = o.id
        JOIN products AS p
            ON p.id = oi.product_id
        WHERE o.status = 'paid'
          AND o.order_year IN (2023, 2024)
        GROUP BY c.country, p.category
    )
)
WHERE category_rank <= 3
  AND orders_2024 > 0
ORDER BY country, category_rank, revenue_2024 DESC;

WITH product_country AS (
    SELECT
        c.country,
        p.id AS product_id,
        p.name AS product_name,
        p.category,
        SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue,
        SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS paid_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS customers
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY c.country, p.id, p.name, p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY country
            ORDER BY revenue DESC, product_id
        ) AS product_rank
    FROM product_country
)
SELECT
    country,
    product_rank,
    product_name,
    category,
    revenue,
    ROUND(100.0 * revenue / NULLIF(country_revenue, 0), 2) AS country_revenue_pct,
    units_sold,
    paid_orders,
    customers
FROM ranked
WHERE product_rank <= 10
ORDER BY country, product_rank
LIMIT 50;
